title: Speaking — Family stories
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on family stories.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
Who usually tells stories about your family?
Do you prefer hearing stories or reading them?

part2.topic: Describe a story about an older person's life that interested you.
part2.closing: and explain what it helped you understand about the past.

questions: What do personal stories contribute to how a country remembers its history?
How can communities record memories that are rarely represented in books?
How has everyday life connected with family stories changed for people of different ages?
